Day 1 | STEGI.RADIO Takeover 2026

Παρασκευή 13 Φεβρουαρίου στις 20:00 | Onassis Stegi

Onassis Stegi transforms for the takeover. The building's usual programming pauses as STEGI.RADIO claims the space, turning the cultural center into a broadcast made physical. You enter not quite a club, not quite a concert, something that exists in the overlap.

STEGI.RADIO Takeover 2026 begins with Day 1 — the opening statement of what promises to be a multi-day investigation into contemporary sound. The Onassis Foundation's radio initiative brings its curatorial vision into three dimensions, translating the intimacy of broadcast into live, shared experience. The programming reflects STEGI.RADIO's aesthetic: electronic and experimental sounds that reward attention.

The Onassis Stegi crowd differs from typical club audiences. These are Athenians who follow the venue's programming, who trust its curatorial judgment, who understand that interesting things happen when a cultural institution turns its resources toward electronic music. The dress code relaxes, the atmosphere shifts, but the underlying seriousness remains.

Onassis Stegi provides world-class facilities — architecture designed by Renzo Piano, infrastructure that supports whatever the programming demands. When the radio takes over, these resources serve sounds that rarely receive such treatment. The quality of presentation matches the ambition of the concept.

If you need traditional club atmosphere or strictly dance-floor programming, the Takeover operates on different logic. This is electronic music in an art context, with all the freedom and challenge that implies. But if you've been curious what happens when a radio station becomes a venue, when broadcast thinking meets physical space — Day 1 begins the experiment.
